notes.title: Text Mix-Up – Hotfix!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much to those of you who pointed this out — and we're really sorry for the confusion![/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what happened: our writer isn’t a native English speaker, so early on we ran the text through a basic spellcheck to help clean things up. That version was never meant to be final — just a rough pass while we kept working on polishing the writing.[/p][p][/p][p]But somewhere along the way, during the build process, the wrong version slipped in. The older, spellchecked draft ended up overwriting the updated one — and we didn’t catch it until now. Totally our mistake.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who flagged this — we really appreciate your help and understanding. And thank you, as always, for playing and supporting.[/p][p][/p][p]The good news: we’ve already fixed the problem and it’s now live in the latest update. Fully cleaned up and polished![/p][p]
See you soon,[/p][p]Mara [/p]

notes.title: Official release date for "Loot Line"
notes.notes:
[b]Ahoy, Loot Line fans![/b]

A bundle of good news for all you pirates and adventurers: [b]Loot Line will be officially released on June 13, 2025![/b] ⏳ The countdown has begun, and we hope you're as eager as we are to set sail on this unforgettable journey.

For those of you new to the crew, here’s a little sneak peek into what you can expect from the game:

💀 [b]A Fantasy Pirate Adventure Like No Other[/b]
Set sail on a high-stakes, adult-themed visual novel where the world is filled with mythical creatures, treasure-laden islands, and a host of intriguing, gorgeous characters.

❤️ [b]Adult Themes, Deep Character Interactions[/b]
With rich character development and plenty of steamy moments, Loot Line is not just about the treasure you’ll find, but the people you meet along the way. Get ready for complex relationships, daring escapades, and lots of twists and turns.

🌴 [b]Mystical Locations & Stunning Art[/b]
Explore breathtaking locations crafted with beautiful art and an eye for detail that pulls you deep into the lore of Loot Line. Every choice you make will guide you deeper into a world of mystery, danger, and of course, adventure.

As always, stay connected with us here for the latest updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes insights as we sail toward launch day!
